summary: Fix undeclared bundling: delete reasoning_checklist.md, restore system.md, clarify S1 names correct skill file and S2 wires its loading

edits.hypothesis: Create skills/task_reasoning_guide.md (not a generic checklist) with concrete, task-family-specific error-prevention patterns (negation in boolean logic, morpheme identification in translation, causation reasoning) targeting observed failure modes to trigger in-context learning
edits.targets_mode: reasoning errors across task families where systematic patterns (negation handling, structural analysis, causal reasoning) address root causes
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prose guidance IS the right lever: frozen model learns from in-context examples and instructions. Concrete, family-specific patterns addressing actual observed errors have better odds than generic checklists.
edits.trigger_condition: Always—system prompt includes skill file on every task
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) F1/F2 fixed extraction format; this fixes reasoning errors those didn't touch. (preservative) Success tasks unaffected—guidance applies equally to correct and incorrect reasoning paths without disrupting output cleanup. (transfer) Generalizes: negation patterns apply to any logic task, morpheme patterns to linguistic tasks, causation patterns to causal reasoning tasks
edits.regression_risk: Guidance could confuse model if it contradicts baseline behavior; mitigated by grounding in concrete examples from traces
edits.mechanism: Create skills/task_reasoning_guide.md (not a generic checklist) with concrete, task-family-specific error-prevention patterns (negation in boolean logic, morpheme identification in translation, causation reasoning) targeting observed failure modes to trigger in-context learning

edits.hypothesis: Wire skills/task_reasoning_guide.md into system prompt construction, appending task-family patterns to base prompt; this makes the skill guidance active without unnecessary context bloat
edits.targets_mode: enabling skill-based reasoning patterns by loading them into model context
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Control_flow: selecting and wiring which skill file loads into system prompt. Without this, skill content never reaches model.
edits.trigger_condition: Every task: harness loads and appends skills/task_reasoning_guide.md to system prompt
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) Completes S1's mechanism. (preservative) Success tasks unaffected—skill loading is transparent; format cleanup (F1, F2) remains. (transfer) Generalizes: skill-file loading pattern is generic, applicable to any task type
edits.regression_risk: Missing/malformed skill file could degrade system prompt; mitigated by safe files.get() with fallback to empty string
edits.mechanism: Wire skills/task_reasoning_guide.md into system prompt construction, appending task-family patterns to base prompt; this makes the skill guidance active without unnecessary context bloat
